name: Missing or Unreconciled Returns
query:
SELECT
    t1.transaction_type,
    t1.order_id,
    t1.sales_invoice,
    t1.return_sales_invoice,
    t1.total
FROM
    `tabAmazon Payment Entry Item` t1
INNER JOIN
    `tabAmazon Payment Entry` pe ON pe.name = t1.parent
WHERE
    t1.transaction_type = 'Refund'
    AND t1.return_sales_invoice IS NOT NULL
    AND t1.return_sales_invoice != ''
    AND pe.docstatus != 2
    AND t1.return_sales_invoice IN (
        SELECT t2.return_sales_invoice
        FROM `tabAmazon Payment Entry Item` t2
        INNER JOIN `tabAmazon Payment Entry` pe2 ON pe2.name = t2.parent
        WHERE t2.transaction_type = 'Refund'
          AND t2.return_sales_invoice IS NOT NULL
          AND t2.return_sales_invoice != ''
          AND pe2.docstatus != 2
        GROUP BY t2.return_sales_invoice
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
    )
ORDER BY
    t1.return_sales_invoice;
